name: Table Row Links
changes: The Table Row Links notice for a Pro feature now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Run Jump to table row... and type part of a label to move the cursor to a marked row in this note.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Table Row Links is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your tables.
